messages.author: de3b3fd8069924e2
messages.subject: threshold/reliable qtls
parts:
Hi

I am just wondering what threshhold i should choose to get real QTLs. As my population is F7 with 98 individuals and 357 markers. Whereas I have choosen cofactors Individual - 12. But sometime I get genetic map with too many cofactors which makes me suspect the result.

I am biologist so cant think in depth what threshold would be good to get reliable qtls.

 

 

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] threshold/reliable qtls
parts:
We usually use a permutation test to establish significance thresholds, but with an F7 population, you perhaps have some population structure that needs to be dealt with, and with population structure a permutation test may be inappropriate.

karl
